text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Spread my toes as wide as I can.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And without rushing a single step...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Grip! Griiiip!! Grip the 
turf............!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Don't pull your legs in! Push... further 
forward!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer sprays cooling spray on me. ...My 
shins and calves had long been screaming 
in spasms.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, there's too much to be conscious 
of, and it's draining my mental energy 
too. ...I can barely breathe. It's 
painful, it's tough. But...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this running style the absolute 
strongest...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A drop of sweat rolled down her chin, 
glistening as it fell. Pushing herself to 
the absolute limit, Kiseki perfected her 
running. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoooosh!!)

text_block_list.name: Evacuating Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaa, this rain is way too much! No 
way! Let's get under some cover!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to heavy rains brought on by the 
approaching typhoon, Kyoto Racecourse was 
hit by a torrential downpour.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume are trudging through the 
heavy mud! This is... this is quite a slow 
pace!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"The track conditions are quite brutal for 
late-surging Betweens and Chasers. Oh, and 
what's more— we have a reverse track 
record...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What is with this track condition...! My 
burst of speed is so much better than 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A desolate environment where just 
standing takes a toll on one's stamina. In 
this situation, Kiseki—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...With the race shaping up to favor the 
front-runners, the standard move would be 
switching tactics to Pace or Front."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If it were "normal," that is.
choice_data_list:
So that means you "won't change it," 
right?

So that means you "won't change it," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I've made up my mind! I'm 
going to blow everyone away with these 
killer legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if "late surging" is at a 
disadvantage, my late surge is different 
from other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My "ground-gripping run" is an invincible 
style that can race on any track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's just as Kiseki says. With the 
running style she devised, she can 
overpower any track condition with sheer 
strength.
choice_data_list:
(Still, using that much power drains her 
stamina, so—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “—I'm fine, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This summer, I'm the Umamusume who got to 
train alongside those Triple Crown 
Umamusume and Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, I'm more confident in 
my stamina than anyone else on this 
track."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll win.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the main character!!
choice_data_list:
...That's right, there's no Uma Musume 
greater than you!

...Yeah, there's no Umamusume greater than 
you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Bring on any torrential rain, bring 
on any impossible challenge!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because of an environment like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—I can depict a thrilling, deeply 
passionate and electrifying development.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
There's no sign of the rain letting up, 
huh. And the race is right around the 
corner too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac, a Junior-class Umamusume 
aiming for the Tiara route. She is also a 
classmate of Kiseki."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Where's Ai-san? She was right here 
just a second ago...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
She dashed right out, saying she wanted to 
get a closer look! You wanna go too, Lala?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...It's about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-chan's Kikka-sho is—!!
